segments.text: ANAC is Canva spelled backwards. A lightning fast browser first design editor for posters, layouts, and social graphics. Local first architecture.
Autosave to index DB. Multi select, group alignment, nested vector drawing areas, image cropping, custom shadows,
native QR code generation. Built-in magic panel brings prompt-driven AI editing straight into your local canvas.
